description: Weather data API for AI agents. Current conditions and 7-day forecast for any location: temperature, humidity, wind speed, precipitation, UV index, and weather description. Worldwide coverage. Tools: data_get_weather. Use this for travel planning, event logistics, agriculture, or location-aware applications. Returns structured data ready for automated decision-making. Returns: {current, forecast[], location}. No API key required — x402 micropayment $0.001/call on Base L2.
name: Weather API — Current & 7-Day Forecast Worldwide
